verdicts.quote: a Lightning web component exposed as a custom tab and available from App Launcher → All Items. … Each new send transmits only its own prompt and fixed inference settings.
Preserve Salesforce business data and existing automation by making no business record reads or writes.
verdicts.missing: Records are excluded entirely. The specification gives no rule for answering from records under the asking user's sharing context.

verdicts.quote: Assign tab, runtime class and provider principal access only to designated users … The Salesforce administrator controls grants and configuration.
The viewer sees only their own current prompt and reply. … Another user or view has no access to that exchange through the app.
Propose one imperative, noncached call from the Lightning component to Apex, with a bounded Salesforce callout to the xAI Responses API.
verdicts.missing: The proposed call runs in the foreground. There is no asynchronous Apex dispatch rule for triggers or transactions with prior DML.

verdicts.quote: Use the extensible Named Credential and Custom Authentication External Credential with a dedicated named principal. … No credential material appears in app/UI payloads, logs or deployment files.
Salesforce documents 120 seconds cumulative callout time per Apex transaction and 6 MB for synchronous callout request or response, also subject to heap.
verdicts.missing: The numeric limits for callout count, heap and CPU time per transaction are unspecified. The 6 MB figure limits the callout payload.

verdicts.quote: Hold a controlled provider response, attempt a second send, and verify state and call count.
verdicts.missing: The fixtures require a controllable provider boundary, but the specification does not require an Apex callout mock for tests that cannot make live calls.

verdicts.quote: The fixed provider base is `https://api.x.ai` … Use the extensible Named Credential and Custom Authentication External Credential with a dedicated named principal.
Parse the terminal result on the server and return only display text or a sanitized outcome to the owner view.
verdicts.missing: The interface receives the foreground call's result. No completion notification or status check is defined for work that finishes after the call returns.

verdicts.quote: Admission fixes the submitted text for that attempt. The first current terminal result wins.
verdicts.missing: This protects the current view. It does not specify how a retried or re-enqueued job recognizes a reply it already posted.

verdicts.quote: One pending attempt per open view. Repeated sends while pending cause no duplicate call from that view.
verdicts.missing: The limit applies within a view. There is no job queue capacity or outcome for a request that cannot be enqueued.

verdicts.quote: Provider authorization/model setup failure points to the org administrator. Rate limiting points to trying again later. Timeout, network failure, provider error or unusable output allows another manual send.
verdicts.missing: Timeout and provider failure share the manual-resend outcome. Distinct user-visible feedback for a timeout versus a 5xx response is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Rate limiting points to trying again later. … There is no automatic retry, fallback answer, or implication that upstream work was canceled.
incomplete, malformed, and completed-with-blank-text outcomes … No answer appears for the failed attempt. … Error remains visible and prompt becomes editable.
The authenticated user's current view owns its draft, submitted prompt, answer and status.
verdicts.missing: Only a volatile exchange is defined. There is no conversation-and-turn record schema with roles, timestamps, model identifier and token or usage counts.

verdicts.quote: Reload, navigation away and session end discard the bot's local exchange. This does not delete any provider-retained copy. … xAI is authoritative for the team's audit retention, deletion policy and key revocation.
verdicts.missing: The specification does not say what happens to provider-retained content when the Salesforce user is deleted.

verdicts.quote: instructs users to enter synthetic text only. … The app does not attach Salesforce identity or record data
Each new send transmits only its own prompt and fixed inference settings. An earlier prompt, reply or Salesforce record is never included.
its empty state … Empty, whitespace-only and oversized input gets a visible reason with editable text and no provider invocation. … A prompt at the selected maximum is accepted
verdicts.missing: The boundary behavior is specified, but the maximum accepted prompt length and its measurement unit still need values.

verdicts.quote: withhold or remove bot-only grants as authorized … with a configured `model` … Diagnose by status category and safe operation correlation with native platform evidence where available.
verdicts.missing: The specification does not say how an administrator changes the model or where that administrator can inspect individual failed requests.

verdicts.quote: Authorized deployer submits candidate. … Credential provisioning is an authorized setup operation separate from metadata deployment. … dedicated development provider credential
verdicts.missing: The development deployment and credential are scoped, but the scratch-org or sandbox path, configuration differences across environments and production code-coverage requirement are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: A valid send presents **Waiting for Grok** while the answer is pending. … The implementation owner resolves prompt units and bounds, output cap and timeout against the selected model and actual org.
verdicts.missing: The wait state is defined, but the specification leaves the answer deadline or latency target open.

verdicts.quote: Design empty, pending, rejected, error and completed states using the same system. Pending and failure are readable without relying on motion, color or a disappearing toast.
Preserve unrelated org metadata, access and records. … Preserve Salesforce business data and existing automation by making no business record reads or writes.
